name: Collei
notes: A Dendro sub-DPS whose Burst (Trump-Card Kitty) is the main hit; both sources put the Burst before the Skill and agree on 4pc Deepwood Memories first, an ER, EM or ATK% Sands, a Dendro DMG Goblet and a crit Circlet. Both give a second, support build (KQM: pure Bloom with EM everywhere; Game8: Burst support with Noblesse Oblige), which the card keeps only as its second set. Elegy for the End and Favonius Warbow are on both weapon lists; Polar Star is Game8's best, KQM does not list it. Neither source gives stat goals; ER 200% is KQM's figure for regular circumstances (180% in a double Dendro team, 160-170% with Favonius Warbow). DMG 46.6% is the Goblet's main stat.
